source_findings.subject: Qwen3-TTS voice-clone wrapper
source_findings.finding: generate_voice_clone(non_streaming_mode=false) currently documents simulated streaming text input rather than true streaming input/generation for this wrapper path.
source_findings.implication: Do not equate model-family streaming claims with the exact Frankenstein voice-clone serving path; TTFA and cancellation must be measured on the exact wrapper/server path selected for F2.

source_findings.subject: NeMo-Speech.cpp MagpieTTS codec streaming
source_findings.finding: The native runtime exposes explicit codec streaming controls including chunk frames, queue depth, history/future frames, overlap window and partial-chunk flush.
source_findings.implication: Magpie v2602/native C++ has a concrete low-level chunking surface suitable for TTFA/jitter/backpressure experiments, but source capability alone grants no Frankenstein runtime credit.

source_findings.subject: NeMo-Speech.cpp server transport
source_findings.finding: The documented realtime WebSocket endpoint is live PCM16 transcription; TTS is documented through /v1/audio/speech and Riva-compatible gRPC while the same process may keep ASR/TTS engines resident.
source_findings.implication: A Frankenstein-grade barge-in test must verify the exact TTS request-abort/audio-drain path and prove unheard speech is stopped and not committed; a generic realtime-server label is insufficient.

source_findings.subject: Piper/Thorsten deterministic floor
source_findings.finding: German Thorsten ONNX artifacts remain small fixed local baselines, including low/medium/high and an emotional-medium variant.
source_findings.implication: Retain Piper/Thorsten as the latency/resource/cancellation floor even if expressive neural challengers win quality.

hypothesis: For Frankenstein's German LOCAL_SOLO voice organ, Magpie/NeMo-Speech.cpp may offer a cleaner native chunk-streaming and co-residency substrate than the current Qwen3-TTS voice-clone wrapper, but Qwen3-TTS may still win German naturalness/identity. The decisive comparison is exact-path TTFA + cancellation/audio-drain correctness + resident footprint, not README-level streaming labels.
counterhypothesis: Qwen3-TTS can be served through a lower-level or alternate true-streaming path that removes the wrapper limitation and outperforms Magpie on both latency and voice quality; therefore the wrapper finding must not be generalized to the whole Qwen3-TTS family.
